2124543370273927362.en_summary: Why are we moving to overnight trading? Despite having shorted $NVDA earlier in the week, I'm still shocked by Friday's trading session in equities - esp into the close. There are various theories about what happened. I suspect that algo fuckery was a strong component. Once these stocks are tradable 23/5, who benefits? Definitely not most individual U.S. market participants. Seems like this is just an open invitation for more algo whipsawing and pure gamblers. I know you're not supposed to cry in the casino, but...IT'S NOT SUPPOSED TO BE A CASINO!
2124543370273927362.zh_summary: 我們為什麼要轉向隔夜交易？儘管本週早些時候做空 $NVDA，我仍對週五股票交易時段感到震驚，尤其是收盤時。關於發生了什麼有各種理論。我懷疑算法操控是重要因素。一旦這些股票可 23/5 交易，誰受益？肯定不是大多數個人美國市場參與者。這似乎只是更多算法鞭打和純粹賭徒的公開邀請。我知道不該在賭場哭，但……它不該是賭場！
